name: @wealthai/astral
description: Astral/Jyotish renderers (docs/49 PH-3, ASTRAL-15..20). ONE implementation of the natal chart, the match scorecard and the muhurta windows, written against a tiny primitive contract so the web app, the AstroMatch extension side panel (380px) and the React Native app all render the same artifact. MUST NOT import DOM or React Native APIs.
